content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: overtime for 48 general and 10 payments agents (11:15-13:00). It is the best available plan, but it still misses the 80% target (70.9% predicted for 10:45-12:45).","why":"General handle time jumped to 744.9 s at 10:30 against 363.0 s forecast. Volume and attendance are normal, which points to a slow tool or process. With no action, service level for 10:45-12:45 is predicted at 45.1%, general queue only 16.0%, and abandons 18.5%. No plan reaches 80%. R1 gets closest at 70.9%, with general at 41.8%, payments at 93.8% and abandons at 7.1%, for INR 13,155. It also lifts rest of day to 84.0%. Its other actions are delaying general breaks 10:45-11:45 by 45 min, cancelling general coaching 11:00-11:59, and 20% chat deflection on balance, new-offer and refund-status calls. Before committing, confirm the slowness with the floor and IT. There is no incident ticket yet, and the spike shows in only one interval.","trade_offs":["Cost: R1 costs INR 13,155. The next best, P4, costs INR 7,485 but reaches only 57.7% (general 31.3%), with 11.3% abandons versus 7.1%.","R2 costs about the same (INR 13,245) but predicts only 57.7% in the disruption window. Its rest-of-day figure is slightly higher (84.7% vs 84.0%), so it does less for the current problem.","The cheap plans P1 (INR 75) and P2 (INR 555) do not help. They predict 43.5% and 44.8%, no better than doing nothing (45.1%), and general falls to around 10%.","Other queue: R1 adds 10 payments overtime agents, so payments is protected and rises to 93.8% rather than being drained to cover general.","Customer impact: R1 has no IVR callbacks. Chat deflection is the only demand lever, so customer friction stays modest.","The general queue stays weak at 41.8% even under R1."],"watch":"Watch general handle time each interval and check with IT whether a system issue is confirmed. If handle time returns towards about 363 s, scale back the overtime. If it stays high and general remains far below 80%, consider involving the duty manager. Also track overtime uptake, since the prediction assumes 48 general and 10 payments agents accept."}
